preamble: The shift from [ə] to [a] is a form of fortition or vowel restoration. It occurs when an inherent or reduced neutral vowel is strengthened, often due to changes in stress or analogy with more open sounds.

examples.note: Dialectal variation recovering the final reduced vowel.
The ancient neutral vowel shifted to a more open quality in many modern descendants.
The consonant after a former schwa is geminated.
